name: StepAudio 3 Realtime (preview)

voice.input_audio: pcm16 (the only format the Realtime API lists); the sample rate is not stated on the pages for this model [step-realtime-api]
voice.output_audio: pcm16 (the only format the Realtime API lists); the sample rate is not stated for this model; the page for the 2.5 model states 24 kHz mono [step-realtime-api] [step-25-realtime]
voice.voices: 7 system voices (soft-spoken-gentleman, magnetic-voiced-male, vibrant-youth, lively-girl, livelybreezy-female, elegantgentle-female, zixinnansheng) and cloned voices made with the StepAudio 2.5 TTS cloning API; the voice cannot change once the model has produced audio [step-realtime-api]
voice.turn_detection: Server VAD is off by default and is turned on with turn_detection.type server_vad: prefix_padding_ms default 500, silence_duration_ms default 100, energy_awakeness_threshold 0 to 5000 default 2500; otherwise the client commits the audio buffer and sends response.create [step-realtime-api]
voice.interruption: StepFun says the user and the model can speak at once, the model stops promptly on a real interruption and keeps the talk coherent through pauses and casual backchannels; with VAD on, the server sends input_audio_buffer.speech_started; response.cancel cancels a response [step-model-page-3] [step-realtime-api]
voice.latency: StepFun publishes no figure; Artificial Analysis measured an average time to first audio of 8.83 seconds on its Big Bench Audio set [aa-s2s]

pricing_usd_per_mtok.notes: Free for a limited time during the preview. StepFun says the preview name will be retired and a paid version added; no price is announced. For comparison the 2.5 model costs US$1.50 input, US$0.30 cached input and US$10.00 output per million tokens [step-pricing] [step-model-page-3]

benchmarks.name: Artificial Analysis Speech Reasoning (Big Bench Audio)
benchmarks.setting: listed as StepAudio 3 Realtime; Artificial Analysis Speech to Speech page, whose table shows 100% rounded; StepFun says the board figures come from internal parameter settings that the API does not yet expose

benchmarks.name: Artificial Analysis Conversational Dynamics (Full Duplex Bench subset)
benchmarks.setting: Artificial Analysis Speech to Speech page, table value; weighted average of pause handling 100, turn-taking 99.2, interruption handling 98.5 and backchannel handling 98.0 from Full Duplex Bench v1 and v1.5; the embedded data holds this result under a separate preview entry

unknown: released: a trade report dates the five-model StepAudio 3 release 2026-09-15 and the technical report was submitted 2026-09-12; StepFun's pages show no release date [runtimewire-step] [step-paper-3]
retires: the preview name will retire when the paid version arrives; no date is published [step-model-page-3]

reasoning: StepFun describes adaptive reasoning and think-while-speaking and documents no switch; the API streams the reasoning text as response.thinking events [step-model-page-3] [step-realtime-api]
